Methodology

Tools

  • playwright — cross-browser automation (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit)
  • Pillow — image loading & size normalization
  • pixelmatch — pixel-level diff with bytearray output buffer

Pipeline

  • Baseline run captures 9 screenshots (3 browsers × 3 viewports)
  • After CSS/content changes, current run captures 9 fresh screenshots
  • visual_diff.py runs Pixelmatch on each pair with threshold 0.10
  • Diff heatmap renders mismatched pixels in red overlay

Severity Classification

  • Critical — diff ≥ 5% of total pixels
  • Warning — diff ≥ 1% and < 5%
  • Minor — diff > 0 and < 1%
  • Pass — diff = 0

Reproducibility

  • Baseline: python3 scripts/screenshot_runner.py baseline file://<target.html> ./baseline
  • Current: python3 scripts/screenshot_runner.py current file://<target_v2.html> ./current
  • Diff: python3 scripts/visual_diff.py ./baseline ./current ./diff 0.10
  • Report: python3 scripts/report_generator.py ./diff ./web_output.html ./baseline ./current
